response.answer: Agree to lead it only if the route can be based on sufficient evidence—especially laboratory comparison or other confirmation that the sightings are linked—rather than proximity alone. A prior pre-lab decision treated nearby reports as one route and sent crews to the wrong wetlands when they proved to be separate introductions. The visible record does not establish other criteria for accepting the role.
